description: Use this when the user wants handwriting worksheets, tracing worksheets, letter tracing or handwriting practice sheets as a printable vector PDF. Supports up to 600 characters and word wrapping. Repeats text to fill each tracing row when repetitions are omitted, or uses an explicit one to four copies, followed by a blank copy row. Does not support cursive. Print letters only. Latin, Greek and Cyrillic supported. Oversized words produce a clear error.

line_size.description: Capital-to-baseline body height in inches: 0.5, 0.625, 0.75 or 1.0. Example: 0.5. Default 0.5.

name_date.description: Print a blank name and date line. Example: true. Default false.

orientation.description: Page direction: portrait or landscape. Example: portrait. Default portrait.

paper.description: Paper: Letter or A4. Example: Letter. Default Letter.

repetitions.description: Whole-number repetitions per tracing row, 1 to 4; each row is followed by a blank copy row. Example: 2. Omit to repeat as many copies as fit, with one body-height gap.

text.description: Letters, words or sentences to trace, up to 600 characters. Example: The cat sat.

title.description: Optional page title, up to 80 supported characters. Example: Letter practice.

trace_style.description: Tracing style: dotted, light_grey or outline. Example: dotted. Default dotted.

name: generate_handwriting_sheet
title: Generate handwriting sheet
